title: An isomorphism of partial subsystems over elementary subsystems is partially elementary
author: Silvia Barbina; Enrique Casanovas
work: The elementary theory of free Steiner triple systems
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled corollary at source lines 1001-1002: for infinite unconfined systems M and N, elementary subsystems A of M and B of N, every isomorphism of the partial structures between A and B is a partial elementary map. The proof (source lines 1003-1007) is a two-stage reduction: the countable case is obtained by replacing each subsystem with the subsystem it generates (which the previous lemma shows to be elementary and isomorphic) and then passing to saturated elementary extensions, and the general case is reduced to the countable one by closing a finite subset of the domain under an HF-ordering with the subsystem as initial segment, so that finite data suffice. The statement records the corollary and neither the reduction nor the use of the finite approximations.
